cards.ex: I spent hours doomscrolling last night and now I feel terrible.
cards.exUz: Men kecha tuni bilan soatlab yomon xabarlarni o'qib chiqdim va endi o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: faqat yomon yangiliklarni o'qish va ko'rish odati, bu stressni oshiradi.

cards.ex: I'm planning a digital detox for the weekend to disconnect and relax.
cards.exUz: Men dam olish kunlarida raqamli detoks qilishni rejalashtiryapman, aloqani uzib, dam olish uchun.
cards.uzDef: texnologiyadan vaqtincha voz kechish, masalan smartfon, kompyuter va ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan.

cards.ex: Be careful of phishing scams that ask for your bank details.
cards.exUz: Bank ma'lumotlaringizni so'ragan firibgarliklardan ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni o'g'irlash maqsadida soxta elektron pochta orqali aldash.

cards.ex: The video of the cat playing the piano went viral overnight.
cards.exUz: Pianino chalayotgan mushukning videosi bir kechada tarqalib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: internetda tez tarqalib, ko'p odamlar tomonidan ko'rilish.

cards.ex: Cybersecurity is a major concern for all companies nowadays.
cards.exUz: Kiberxavfsizlik hozirgi kunda barcha kompaniyalar uchun katta muammo.
cards.uzDef: kompyuter va internet ma'lumotlarini himoya qilish tizimi.

cards.ex: You need to be tech-savvy to work in this field.
cards.exUz: Bu sohada ishlash uchun siz texnologiyalardan xabardor bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: texnologiyalarni yaxshi tushunuvchi va mohirlik bilan ishlatuvchi.

cards.ex: It's important to maintain a professional online presence.
cards.exUz: Professional onlayn mavjudlikni saqlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: internetdagi shaxsiy yoki biznes profil, veb-sayt, ijtimoiy tarmoqlardagi faollik.

cards.ex: Think carefully about your digital footprint before posting anything online.
cards.exUz: Onlaynda biror narsa joylashtirishdan oldin raqamli izingiz haqida yaxshilab o'ylab ko'ring.
cards.uzDef: internetda qoldirilgan ma'lumotlar, xabarlar, rasmlar va boshqa narsalar.

cards.ex: I often scroll through social media when I'm bored.
cards.exUz: Zerikkanimda ko'pincha ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni varaqlayman.
cards.uzDef: ekrandagi ma'lumotlarni tezda ko'rish uchun yuqoriga yoki pastga siljitish.

cards.ex: Don't forget to log in to your account before starting work.
cards.exUz: Ishni boshlashdan oldin hisobingizga kirishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: saytga yoki dasturga foydalanuvchi nomi va parol bilan kirish.

cards.ex: You need to sign up for an account to use this app.
cards.exUz: Bu ilovani ishlatish uchun siz hisob yaratib, ro'yxatdan o'tishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: xizmat, dastur yoki saytga a'zo bo'lish uchun ro'yxatdan o'tish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Social media helps people stay connected with friends and family.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar odamlarga do'stlari va oilasi bilan aloqada bo'lishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: internet, telefon yoki ijtimoiy tarmoqlar orqali doimiy aloqada bo'lish.

cards.ex: I found a supportive online community for writers.
cards.exUz: Men yozuvchilar uchun qo'llab-quvvatlovchi onlayn jamoa topdim.
cards.uzDef: internetda umumiy manfaatlar asosida birlashgan odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: This app is very user-friendly, even for beginners.
cards.exUz: Bu ilova juda qulay, hatto yangi boshlanuvchilar uchun ham.
cards.uzDef: ishlatish oson, tushunarli interfeysga ega.

cards.ex: We need more bandwidth to stream videos smoothly.
cards.exUz: Videolarni muammosiz uzatish uchun bizga ko'proq o'tkazuvchanlik kerak.
cards.uzDef: ma'lumotlarni uzatish tezligi yoki imkoniyati.

cards.ex: I use cloud storage to back up all my important files.
cards.exUz: Men barcha muhim fayllarimni zaxiralash uchun bulutli xotiradan foydalanaman.
cards.uzDef: ma'lumotlarni internetdagi serverda saqlash.

cards.ex: The company is developing cutting-edge AI technology.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya eng so'nggi sun'iy intellekt texnologiyasini ishlab chiqmoqda.
cards.uzDef: eng zamonaviy, yangi va innovatsion texnologiya.

cards.ex: Digital natives are comfortable using new technologies.
cards.exUz: Raqamli avlod yangi texnologiyalardan foydalanishda o'zini qulay his qiladi.
cards.uzDef: texnologiya bilan o'sgan avlod, texnologiyani yaxshi biluvchi.

cards.ex: YouTube is a popular online platform for sharing videos.
cards.exUz: YouTube - videolarni baham ko'rish uchun mashhur onlayn platforma.
cards.uzDef: internetda xizmatlar taklif qiluvchi sayt yoki dastur.

cards.ex: Virtual reality is used in gaming and education.
cards.exUz: Virtual reallik o'yinlarda va ta'limda qo'llaniladi.
cards.uzDef: kompyuter tomonidan yaratilgan sun'iy muhit.

cards.ex: Augmented reality apps are becoming more common.
cards.exUz: Kengaytirilgan reallik ilovalari tobora keng tarqalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: haqiqiy dunyoni kompyuter grafikasi bilan boyitish.

cards.ex: The company announced a data breach affecting millions of users.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya millionlab foydalanuvchilarga ta'sir qiluvchi ma'lumotlar buzilishi haqida e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: shaxsiy ma'lumotlarning ruxsatsiz kirish natijasida o'g'irlanishi.

cards.ex: We need to bridge the digital divide and provide access to technology for everyone.
cards.exUz: Biz raqamli tafovutni bartaraf etishimiz va hammaga texnologiyaga kirish imkoniyatini berishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: texnologiyaga kirish imkoniyatidagi tengsizlik.

cards.ex: Could you mute yourself when you're not speaking?
cards.exUz: Gapirmayotganingizda ovozingizni o'chirib qo'yishingiz mumkinmi?
cards.uzDef: onlayn uchrashuvda yoki qo'ng'iroqda birovning ovozini o'chirish.

cards.ex: Streaming videos can be a real bandwidth hog.
cards.exUz: Videolarni oqimlash haqiqiy o'tkazuvchanlikni yeyuvchi bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: internet aloqasidan katta miqdordagi o'tkazuvchanlikni ishlatadigan dastur yoki faoliyat.

cards.ex: She threw shade at my new phone on social media.
cards.exUz: U ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda mening yangi telefonimni kinoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: birovni nozik, ammo salbiy tarzda tanqid qilish.

cards.ex: I need to unplug this weekend and just relax.
cards.exUz: Men dam olish kunlarida texnologiyadan uzoqlashib, dam olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: texnologiyadan (telefon, kompyuter) vaqtincha uzoqlashish.

cards.ex: We met online and then met IRL a few weeks later.
cards.exUz: Biz onlayn tanishdik va keyin bir necha hafta o'tgach haqiqiy hayotda uchrashdik.
cards.uzDef: internetdan tashqari, real hayotda.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a little behind the curve when it comes to new gadgets.
cards.exUz: Yangi gadjetlar haqida gap ketganda, men biroz ortda qolayotgandek his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: yangi texnologiyalar yoki tendentsiyalardan xabardor emas.

cards.ex: This printer is plug and play, so it's easy to set up.
cards.exUz: Bu printer 'uladi va ishlat' turiga kiradi, shuning uchun uni o'rnatish oson.
cards.uzDef: o'rnatishni talab qilmaydigan, ulagandan so'ng darhol ishlaydigan.
